scope: Fixed acoustic inputs only: encoder/flow plus 256-frame chunked vocoder. No GPT/frontend/reference preparation latency or full-engine memory claim.
verification_scope: 41 saved first-output NPZ waveform/PCM arrays independently read and hashed; every recorded repetition digest and bitwise flag checked against those first arrays and prior host control. Later execution arrays were not separately persisted.
conclusion: No measured performance benefit in this probe: device-resident latent preserves host-control waveform/PCM bytes, but all four acoustic hot medians are slightly slower and sampled acoustic memory delta is slightly higher. Keep experimental; do not promote as an optimization win.

current_source_audit.scope: Current disk hashes are separate from completed-run source identities. A later edit does not change each run's recorded sources_changed verdict.
current_source_audit.docstring_verification: The verification replaces exactly 'owned contiguous CUDA buffers' with the prior phrase 'contiguous OrtValues' and compares the complete file SHA-256 against every device run.
